h1: Custom 1 Lip Balm for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 1 lip balm in bulk for your brand. Perfect for giveaways and events at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: When you need a single, compact lip balm for cost-effective giveaways, a 1-count size keeps things simple. These small tubes and tins are easy to hand out at trade shows, fit into welcome bags, and leave a lasting impression without breaking your budget. Options like our Chap Ice® SPF 15 Lip Balm or the All Natural Lip Balm Tin can be imprinted with your logo for a practical, year-round promotional item.
heroAltText: Custom 1 lip balm in assorted colors with logos, including Chap Ice SPF 15 and All Natural Lip Balm Tin
